answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a refundable stake before it can earn fees, then using random cross checks: a falcon agent compares another agent’s work with a signal from an established anchor, and inconsistent reports trigger slashing. Creating thousands of fake identities therefore forces the attacker to lock proportional capital in each one, while coordinated fraud risks losing the entire bond. Honest identities recover their stake and gain reputation.
